name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: Mutual NDA governing how both parties use and protect confidential information shared for a stated purpose.

fields.label: Purpose
fields.description: How Confidential Information may be used
fields.default: Evaluating whether to enter into a business relationship with the other party.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.description: The date the MNDA starts

fields.label: MNDA Term
fields.description: How long the MNDA lasts, e.g. 'Expires 1 year from Effective Date' or 'Continues until terminated in accordance with the terms of the MNDA'

fields.label: Term of Confidentiality
fields.description: How long Confidential Information is protected, e.g. '1 year from Effective Date, but in the case of trade secrets until Confidential Information is no longer considered a trade secret under applicable laws' or 'In perpetuity'
fields.default: 1 year from Effective Date, but in the case of trade secrets until Confidential Information is no longer considered a trade secret under applicable laws.

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.description: The US state whose laws govern the agreement, e.g. Delaware

fields.label: Jurisdiction
fields.description: The city or county and state whose courts hear disputes, e.g. courts located in New Castle, DE

fields.label: MNDA Modifications
fields.description: Any changes to the Standard Terms

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Standard terms for selling and buying cloud software (SaaS), covering access and use, support, fees, data, warranties, liability, and term.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.description: The date the agreement starts

fields.label: Cloud Service
fields.description: The cloud service (SaaS product) the Customer is buying

fields.label: Order Date
fields.description: The date of the order

fields.label: Subscription Period
fields.description: Length of each subscription term, e.g. 1 year

fields.label: Fees
fields.description: Subscription fees and how they are invoiced

fields.label: Technical Support
fields.description: Support the Provider offers, e.g. email support during business hours

fields.label: Non-Renewal Notice Date
fields.description: How far before the end of a Subscription Period a party must give notice not to renew
fields.default: 30 days before the end of the current Subscription Period

fields.label: General Cap Amount
fields.description: Cap on each party's liability
fields.default: The fees paid or payable by Customer in the 12 months before the claim

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.description: The US state whose laws govern the agreement, e.g. Delaware

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.description: The courts that hear disputes, e.g. the state and federal courts in New Castle County, Delaware

name: AI Addendum
description: Addendum to a service agreement covering a provider's AI services: use of customer input, generated output, restrictions, and model training.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.description: The date the addendum starts

fields.label: Training Data
fields.description: Customer data the Provider may use to train models; 'None' means no training is permitted

fields.label: Training Purposes
fields.description: Purposes for which training is permitted, if any

fields.label: Training Restrictions
fields.description: Restrictions on any permitted training

fields.label: Improvement Restrictions
fields.description: Restrictions on using Input and Output to improve the AI system without training

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: HIPAA business associate agreement setting out how a provider may use, disclose, and safeguard protected health information (PHI) for a covered entity.

fields.label: Agreement
fields.description: The underlying services agreement this BAA supplements

fields.label: BAA Effective Date
fields.description: The date the BAA starts

fields.label: Breach Notification Period
fields.description: How quickly the Provider must report a breach of unsecured PHI

fields.label: Limitations
fields.description: Any limits on how the Provider may use or disclose PHI

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Agreement giving a design partner early access to a product in exchange for feedback and participation in a development program.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.description: The date the agreement starts

fields.label: Program
fields.description: The design partner program: the product and what the Partner will do

fields.label: Term
fields.description: How long the agreement lasts

fields.label: Fees
fields.description: Fees the Partner pays, if any

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.description: The US state whose laws govern the agreement, e.g. Delaware

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.description: The courts that hear disputes

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Data processing terms defining controller and processor roles, subprocessors, security, international transfers, and compliance with data protection laws such as GDPR.

fields.label: Agreement
fields.description: The underlying services agreement this DPA supplements

fields.label: Nature and Purpose of Processing
fields.description: What processing the Provider does and why

fields.label: Duration of Processing
fields.description: How long processing continues
fields.default: For the term of the Agreement

fields.label: Categories of Data Subjects
fields.description: Whose personal data is processed, e.g. Customer's employees and end users

fields.label: Categories of Personal Data
fields.description: What personal data is processed, e.g. names and email addresses

fields.label: Special Category Data
fields.description: Any special category (sensitive) personal data processed

fields.label: Special Category Data Restrictions or Safeguards
fields.description: Safeguards applied to special category data

fields.label: Frequency of Transfer
fields.description: How often data is transferred

fields.label: Approved Subprocessors
fields.description: Subprocessors the Provider may use

fields.label: Provider Security Contact
fields.description: Who to contact about security issues

fields.label: Security Policy
fields.description: The Provider's security measures or policy

fields.label: Governing Member State
fields.description: EU member state whose law governs the standard contractual clauses, e.g. Ireland

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Agreement for a business partnership between a company and a partner, covering each party's obligations, fees and payment, a trademark license, liability, indemnification, and term.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.description: The date the agreement starts

fields.label: End Date
fields.description: When the partnership ends

fields.label: Obligations
fields.description: What each party will do under the partnership

fields.label: Territory
fields.description: Where the partnership applies

fields.label: Payment Schedule
fields.description: Fees or revenue share and when they are paid

fields.label: Payment Process
fields.description: How payments are made, e.g. invoiced monthly, due in 30 days

fields.label: Brand Guidelines
fields.description: Guidelines for using each other's trademarks

fields.label: General Cap Amount
fields.description: Cap on each party's liability

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.description: The US state whose laws govern the agreement, e.g. Delaware

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.description: The courts that hear disputes

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Short-term trial or evaluation agreement that lets a prospective customer test a product before committing to a full commercial contract.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.description: The date the pilot starts

fields.label: Product
fields.description: The product being piloted

fields.label: Pilot Period
fields.description: How long the pilot lasts

fields.label: Fees
fields.description: Fees for the pilot, if any

fields.label: General Cap Amount
fields.description: Cap on each party's liability

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.description: The US state whose laws govern the agreement, e.g. Delaware

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.description: The courts that hear disputes

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Standard terms for professional services delivered under statements of work (SOWs), covering performance, deliverables, fees, IP ownership, and liability.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.description: The date the agreement starts

fields.label: Services
fields.description: The professional services the Provider will perform

fields.label: Deliverables
fields.description: What the Provider will deliver

fields.label: Fees
fields.description: Fees for the services, e.g. fixed fee or hourly rates

fields.label: Payment Period
fields.description: When invoices must be paid

fields.label: SOW Term
fields.description: How long the statement of work lasts

fields.label: General Cap Amount
fields.description: Cap on each party's liability

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.description: The US state whose laws govern the agreement, e.g. Delaware

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.description: The courts that hear disputes

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Service level terms for a cloud service defining target uptime, response times, how availability is calculated, and service credits.

fields.label: Target Uptime
fields.description: Monthly availability target

fields.label: Uptime Credit
fields.description: Service credit if uptime falls below the target

fields.label: Target Response Time
fields.description: How quickly the Provider responds to support requests

fields.label: Response Time Credit
fields.description: Service credit if the response time target is missed

fields.label: Support Channel
fields.description: Where support requests are sent, e.g. support@provider.com

fields.label: Scheduled Downtime
fields.description: Planned maintenance windows excluded from uptime

name: Software License Agreement
description: Standard terms for licensing on-premise or self-installed software, covering license scope, support, fees, warranties, liability, and term.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.description: The date the agreement starts

fields.label: Software
fields.description: The software being licensed

fields.label: Order Date
fields.description: The date of the order

fields.label: Subscription Period
fields.description: Length of each license term

fields.label: Permitted Uses
fields.description: What the Customer may use the software for

fields.label: License Limits
fields.description: Limits such as number of users or installations

fields.label: Fees
fields.description: License fees and how they are invoiced

fields.label: Warranty Period
fields.description: How long the software warranty lasts

fields.label: General Cap Amount
fields.description: Cap on each party's liability

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.description: The US state whose laws govern the agreement, e.g. Delaware

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.description: The courts that hear disputes
